question: How many patients do each physician take care of? List their names and number of patients they take care of.
failed_sql: SELECT T1.name ,  count(*) FROM Physician AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.id
teacher_sql:
SELECT T1.Name, COUNT(*) 
FROM Physician AS T1 
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.EmployeeID = T2.PCP 
GROUP BY T1.EmployeeID

question: What is all the information regarding employees who are managers?
teacher_sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.* FROM employees e JOIN employees em ON e.EMPLOYEE_ID = em.MANAGER_ID

question: What is the average cost of procedures that physician John Wen was trained in?
failed_sql: SELECT avg(cost) FROM Physician JOIN Procedures ON Physician.id = Procedures Physician_id WHERE Physician_name = "John Wen"
teacher_sql: SELECT AVG(PR.Cost) FROM Physician P JOIN Trained_In T ON P.EmployeeID = T.Physician JOIN Procedures PR ON T.Treatment = PR.Code WHERE P.Name = 'John Wen'
